_derivation.note: The Google Business Profile Performance API is small and fully enumerable: the DailyMetric enum is a fixed set of 11 requestable daily counts (all additive), transcribed in official_fields.json from https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/performance/rest/v1/DailyMetric. No enrichment source (GBP is not a Supermetrics source). field_discovery.mode=static. The daily performance surface is the core; search keywords (monthly) and reviews (legacy v4, allowlist-gated) are separate planned facets.
_derivation.central_design_fact: HAS history but HARD-CAPPED at ~18 MONTHS (daily) -- data older than 18 months from the request date is unreachable. There is no backfill beyond that window: the connector must sync early and persist to the warehouse for anything longer (YoY). Plus a ~3-7 day reporting lag on recent days, and zero-days OMITTED from datedValues (gap-fill to 0).
_derivation.access_gate: DEFAULT quota is 0 QPM: a newly-enabled project is un-runnable until Google manually approves an access/quota request (no sandbox). Approved default = 300 QPM. Reviews (v4) additionally require allowlisting. These are provisioning gates, not auth-flow changes.

_also._note: GET locations/{location}:fetchMultiDailyMetricsTimeSeries?dailyMetrics=&dailyRange.startDate=&dailyRange.endDate= -> multiDailyMetricTimeSeries[].dailyMetricTimeSeries[].timeSeries.datedValues[].{date,value}. value = stringified int64. Daily grain.
locations/{location_id} = the reporting entity (Performance + Reviews take this id).
Legacy My Business API v4 host mybusiness.googleapis.com/v4. DEPRECATED surface but reviews still active 2026; ALLOWLIST-gated (403 without grant). Isolate behind an adapter.
Single scope business.manage (read/write, no read-only). Default 0 QPM until access granted; approved 300 QPM.

_no_enrichment: GBP is NOT a Supermetrics source. The official DailyMetric enum + the v4 reviews / monthly search-keyword schemas are the sole authority -- sufficient because the surfaces are small and static.

_field_discovery.note: Fixed DailyMetric enum + fixed v4/monthly schemas. No per-account custom fields. Full set committed in api_catalog.json.

probe.structural_note: fetchMultiDailyMetricsTimeSeries for ONE known location id over a 1-day window carries all requested DailyMetric series -> each cataloged metric records ok|empty by presence. Reviews (v4) + monthly search keywords probed separately once the account is allowlisted. Requires a granted (>0 QPM) project + a real GBP location; deferred (no test account 2026-07-21).

_verification.note: No GBP test account AND default 0-QPM access gate (2026-07-21). Ratification deferred until a real GBP account with granted quota exists.
